## CAGE operational merge policy

Before CAGE operational merge decisions, load the canonical [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/brickbruce1975-ship-it/cage-agi-orchestrator/blob/main/AGENTS.md), its gateway contract and current active task context, and the [operational merge policy](https://github.com/brickbruce1975-ship-it/cage-agi-orchestrator/blob/main/governance/OPERATIONAL_MERGE_AUTONOMY_POLICY_V1.json). Current merged canonical policy governs every provider; this repository is a gateway to that shared authority. Apply this standing rule only while the current merged canonical policy enables it and existing task authority covers the action.

Within already-authorized operational work, resolve blockers and feedback, obtain independent development-side review, satisfy the policy's applicable checks for the intended head and current base, then mark ready and merge through the normal provider flow without another owner prompt. Verify the resulting target branch and retain a versioned receipt. Report an existing authorized owner PR exception when used, including the actual separate approval count; do not invent approvals or change provider rules.

This instruction narrowly supersedes earlier blanket directions to stop after drafting or always request another merge prompt for that already-authorized operational work. Preserve repo-specific requirements and task limits. It does not authorize new tasks, frozen or preregistered experiment changes, deployment, secrets, spending, provider administration, or RSI/AGI claim changes. Failing, cancelled, stale, skipped, or absent checks require the canonical policy's explicit applicability decision; they are not automatically green.
